questions: Q1: Does the CLI heading extraction handle both HTML and Markdown after prior runs?
Q2: Is the CLI comment system format-agnostic?

answers.answer: Yes. show.ts lines 47-67 try an HTML heading regex first, extracting level, id attribute, and inner text with HTML tag stripping (line 52). Lines 69-85 fall back to Markdown heading regex. Both produce identical annotation output with comment counts.

Yes. comments-list.ts and comments-post.ts use anchor-based section targeting via --section flag. The anchor string matches heading id/slug regardless of source format. No format-specific logic exists.
evidence: comments-post.ts lines 63-67: submits anchor, rating, content, parentCommentId
comments-list.ts: groups comments by section anchor

statement: The CLI is fully compatible with HTML reports from prior runs. Dual heading extraction handles both formats with identical output. Comment system is anchor-based and format-agnostic. No code changes needed.
